Contact our team
How do I measure for custom blinds?

Start with the mount type. An inside mount sits within the frame. An outside mount overlaps it. Measure each opening separately and check the requirements for your chosen product.

Can I order samples before I buy?

Yes. Choose up to 15 free samples from the available materials and finishes on the free samples page.

Can I replace just the slats?

Yes. Match the width, length, and attachment style of an existing vane and browse replacement slats. If you are unsure about a match, contact the team with a photo.

When is shipping free?

Perfecto Blinds offers free shipping on orders over $100. See available delivery options and current terms when placing your order.

How does price matching work?

Contact customer service within 24 hours of purchase if you find a lower listed price from another online retailer for the same brand, item, size, and color.

    Measure your window

    Use a steel tape and measure each opening separately.

    Inside mount

    Measure inside the frame across the top, middle, and bottom, and check the depth for the brackets. Measure the height on the left, center, and right.

    Outside mount

    Measure the full area you want covered, including space beyond the opening above and on either side. Leave room for the mounting hardware.

    Check the product instructions for which measurements to enter and whether the manufacturer takes deductions.
